verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Qapita can issue and track equity and manage grants, and it offers free migration from Pulley. None of it documents bulk upload or batch issuance of grants or historical transactions. The migration offer is a vendor service, not a self-serve bulk-import capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can upload or issue securities in bulk — a batch of grants or historical transactions — instead of entering them one at a time
